exchanges: ugh mondays. survived my first week at halvorsen tho so thats something
Congrats on getting through the first week, that's a real milestone!
the boss there, rupert, talks so fast i just nod like i understand
Nodding along is a time-honoured strategy, you'll catch his pace soon.
commute is kinda nice tho, i take the ferry across every morning and just stare at the water
That sounds like a pretty peaceful way to start the day.
my sister ysolde finally adopted a cat lol
Oh that's lovely, a new family member!
she called it pumpernickel which is the most her thing ever
That's an adorable name, it sounds like it has character.
apparently its a korat, i had to google what that even is
Ha, there are so many breeds out there that most people have never heard of.
lunch was leftover soup again. i rly need to meal prep
Leftover soup still counts as a win, but meal prep could save you some stress.
my wrist is killing me, doc says its tendonitis from all the typing
Ouch, I hope you can rest it a bit and get some relief soon.
tamsin from accounting gave me a lift home in her saab, the thing makes noises
Sounds like a ride with a bit of personality!
kind of tired today, slept badly
Sorry to hear that, maybe an early night will help.
ysolde lives way out in dunmarrow so i dont get to see the cat much
That's a shame, hopefully you'll get a visit in when things calm down.
my sister in law is the opposite, shes right in the middle of town in keswold
Handy having someone close by right in town.
watched the rain for like an hour instead of doing laundry
Honestly, rain watching is a perfectly valid use of time.
okello is learning the bassoon for some reason, his neighbours must love him
That's a brave instrument to take up, good on him.
started middlemarch on the boat this morning, its sooo long
It's a big one, but lots of people say it's worth the slog.
might go to the market saturday if the weather holds
Fingers crossed for a dry day, markets are lovely.
my dad keeps telling stories about growing up in glenvarra like its a fairy tale
Those old hometown stories can be the best ones.
had khruangbin on repeat all afternoon, best band ever honestly
Nothing like a favourite band on loop to carry you through an afternoon.
rupert said im doing fine so far, so relieved
That's great feedback to get early on!
thinking of making pasta tonight, nothing fancy
Simple pasta is one of life's great comforts.
kinda want a nap but its way too early
A short rest might still do you good.
okello texted, hes been doing falconry on weekends now?? the man has range
He really does seem to collect unusual pastimes!
anyway im gonna go fold that laundry finally
Good luck, future you will be grateful.
tamsin's coming over friday to watch a movie, should be fun
That sounds like a fun way to end the week.
